constraints: Each product carries a brand of its own and calls for backing on the one shared Patreon.
A backer's points are one pool across every product, and every reading of those points is filtered to one product.
Nothing Alan makes is held back from anyone; backing buys weight in what Alan builds next and nothing else.
Alan keeps full discretion over what he builds, and points committed to a request he denies are refunded.

intentStack.statement: Alan has a Patreon page people can back him on.
A patron is a page holding every point transaction and the balance those transactions reach.
Every feature request is a page naming the product that request is for.
A pledge Patreon reports lands the patron's page and the points that pledge earns.
Anyone reaches a public site holding every published feature request and its points.
intentStack.workingMemory: Which domain this site is served under, and what it is branded as, is unsettled and waits on Alan.

intentStack.statement: Every product Alan has live has a view of the feature requests for that product.
Every feature Alan already means to build is a published feature request.
A patron commits points to a published feature request.
Anyone proposes a feature request, and Alan's review is what publishes that request.
A command completes a feature request, burning its points, or denies it, refunding them.
